Package eu.algites.lib.storage.object

Interface AIiObjectStorageObjectMetadata

public interface AIiObjectStorageObjectMetadata
Immutable snapshot of metadata for one observed stored object. Metadata is descriptive, not an independently verified content integrity proof.

    • getSha256

      String getSha256()
      Optional SHA-256 hexadecimal content checksum. May be provider metadata supplied by the uploader; security-sensitive callers must verify bytes. It must never be confused with S3 multipart ETag.

    • getRevisionToken

      String getRevisionToken()
      Opaque backend concurrency token for this exact key/revision, or null if no strong conditional update token can be supplied. Not a content hash. The token must be usable without translation by the same backend's CAS API.

    • getLastModifiedAt

      Instant getLastModifiedAt()
      Server-observed modification time if available; never a CAS identity.
